name: Gemmy
description:
In a land where gems roamed freely, one gem encountered another, and another, each embodying its unique brilliance. Finding kinship in a shared vision, a zest for pioneering tech, and the thrill of mischief. Thus, the story of the Gemmy began. As word spread, countless other gems resonated with this vibe, calling for an epic convergence of LOLs. And so, Pearls rained down.

Welcome to the Gemmy collection, a digital collectible drop within Pearls by Gems - a space where artists, creators, and projects partner with the Getgems team, crafting curated art in a collaborative showcase.
